assets.name: first-dance-hero
assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: a single unretouched wedding photograph for a culling application's sample shoot, landscape 3:2, highest detail.
Primary request: a believable documentary wedding first-dance frame a discerning working photographer would keep for emotion and timing, not an advertising shoot. One photograph, edge to edge, no contact sheet or UI.
Scene: modest converted brick-and-timber reception hall at night. Dim tungsten wall lamps, a few out-of-focus guests at round tables, scuffed wooden dance floor. Mixed warm practical light and a small bounced on-camera flash. Dark corners remain dark, restrained highlights, realistic white balance and slight high-ISO chroma noise.
Subjects: two fictional newlyweds about 30. Woman with warm olive skin, brown eyes, shoulder-length dark wavy hair loosely pinned at the nape with escaped strands, a simple ivory satin narrow-strap dress, no veil, no ornate jewellery. Man with medium brown skin, short dark curls, a slightly crooked nose and light stubble, black single-breasted suit with white shirt and loosened black tie. She is left of him; they are dancing close, quietly laughing with faces turned to each other, visible eyes, no gaze at the camera.
Composition: medium wide horizontal shot from a guest's eye level, 50mm documentary lens around f/2.8, 1/160 s, ISO 3200. Their heads and upper bodies read clearly in the central two-thirds; enough reception context and a softly occluding guest shoulder at the far left edge. An unposed moment between poses, slightly asymmetrical framing.
Materials: real pores and expression lines, irregular hair strands, uneven soft highlights on satin, wrinkled shirt fabric, natural teeth not gleaming identical veneers. Optical background falloff rather than smeared fake bokeh. Flash falloff consistent with room geometry.
Constraints: physically correct hands and arms, credible human anatomy, no excessive retouching, no glossy fashion perfection, no orange/teal cinematic grade, no HDR, no luminous haze, no skin smoothing, no illustration, no decorative sparkles, no text, no watermarks. A technically competent but ordinary camera preview with emotional specificity, not a polished final delivery.
